parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The UID of the member accounts of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: NatGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT gateway.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The page number of the current page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

parameters.name: ProxyId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT firewall.

parameters.name: ProxyName
parameters.description: The name of the NAT firewall. The name can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length and cannot start with an underscore.

parameters.name: RegionNo
parameters.description: The region ID of the VPC.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of Cloud Firewall. Valid values:

- **configuring**: Being created.
- **deleting**: Being deleted.
- **normal**: Normal.
- **abnormal**: Abnormal.
- **opening**: Being enabled.
- **closing**: Being disabled.
- **closed**: Disabled.
